thread:
emily: quick PSA: our last packaging tweak (tight exports map) broke a handful of onboarding examples in edge-like runtimes and in alternative JS runtimes (bun/deno). Node ESM/CJS local tests passed so it slipped through.
nikhil: what symptoms are people hitting? stacktraces?
emily: two flavors: (1) ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND when importing the package root in Cloudflare/Vercel edge builds; (2) Deno/npm:specifier error when someone uses `npm:redwood-sdk` in deno.
carlos: looks like we only exposed subpaths (`./client`, `./server`) and no root (`.`) entry in the exports map. many users still do `import sdk from 'redwood-sdk'` in examples.
jen: Also noticed TypeScript consumers complaining: "Could not find a declaration file for module 'redwood-sdk'" — our root types pointer is missing from exports.
emily: current shipped snippet was basically: "\"exports\": { \"./client\": \"./dist/esm/client.js\", \"./server\": \"./dist/cjs/server.js\" }" which blocks root, package.json, and wildcard resolution.
nikhil: quick compatibility patch suggestion: add a root export that provides import/require/types, expose ./package.json, and a catch-all for subpaths. e.g.:
```
"exports": {
  ".": { "import": "./dist/esm/index.js", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js", "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts" },
  "./*": "./dist/*",
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```
jen: that should fix edge + deno + bun. For Deno we might also ship a `dist/deno/mod.ts` that re-exports the ESM entry; helps folks who import via `npm:` specifier fallback.
carlos: add `main` and `module` fields back in package.json for older bundlers/legacy tools — they read those fields even if exports exists.
emily: operationally: I'll open a packaging PR with the export fixes + types pointer and add a small compatibility test in sample-apps CI. Proposed CI steps: (1) esbuild build with `--platform=neutral`, (2) bun run build, (3) deno bundle ./dist/deno/mod.ts, (4) run wrangler dev or Miniflare smoke test for edge resolution.
nikhil: also add a lint that validates exports map includes `.` and `./package.json` entries. makes sense to catch regressions early.
jen: put a changelog note and a migration blurb: "If you imported the package root, no action required; if you relied on internal subpaths, consider switching to explicit subpath imports to be future-proof."
ci-bot: ACTION: create draft PR -> run canary publish to staging registry -> update sample-apps -> run CI matrix.
emily: thanks — adding @devex and @eng-runtime to track. I'll include a short repro in the PR that demonstrates the Cloudflare worker resolution failure so reviewers can validate the fix quickly.
nikhil: one small gotcha: some edge bundlers prefer `.mjs` ext or enforce "type":"module" semantics. verify our ESM build has consistent extensions and no CJS bits in top-level.
carlos: agreed. I'll run a quick audit script to detect any CJS-looking `module.exports` in the ESM bundle and ensure source maps are present for debugging.
emily: perfect. Targeting patch publish to staging today. Will post PR link here when ready. Thanks!
